content: Jin read the imperial decree. 'Year 3042 of the Celestial Era: Mount Hua disciples deserted the Kurukshetra front, sabotaging the automated defense grid.' Jin analyzed the syntactic phrasing. 'Algorithmic propaganda generated by Moon Intelligence Sector 4.'
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Propaganda analysis, algorithmic origin identification.

content: "They call us traitors," Yoon Jong whispered, pointing with a trembling finger to the black brushstrokes. "The empire recorded that our ancestors fled the demon war and left the Central Plains to burn." Jin stared at the page, the ink turning red in his peripheral vision. "Kamina burned his soul to ash," Jin murmured. "And they wrote that he ran."
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Heartbreaking emotional betrayal, Kamina named.

content:
"Traitors?" Jin whispered. His voice was so calm, so quiet, that Yoon Jong's knees nearly gave out in sheer terror. "My brother cleaved the Demon King's arm off and detonated the Solar Lotus... and these ink-stained vermin wrote that we fled?"
Jin looked at the ceiling and began to laugh—a soft, dry, terrifying chuckle that had zero humor in it.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Terrifying quiet laughter, chilling contrast to loud comedy.
